verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a one-click install that grants an agent access to repositories. The GitHub integration is described only as creating tasks from issues and linking artifacts back. Repository access otherwise comes from local workspace config or from choosing a host that already has the code and credentials, which is user-side setup rather than one-click access.

support.subject: As a developer, I can grant an agent access to my repositories with a one-click install, without complex setup
